observations: White microwave oven with a black control panel and door frame.
Brand 'AKAI' is printed on the top right of the control panel in photo 0 and photo 1.
Two rotary dials are visible: one for power levels (Low, Med, High, Combi.1, Combi.2, Combi.3, Grill) and one for timer/defrost (0-35 minutes).
The microwave door has a glass window and a metal handle.
The unit is sitting on a wooden surface or stand.
The interior of the microwave is visible in photos 0 and 1, showing a circular metal rack.
The exterior casing shows some surface wear and minor scuffs, especially on the top and sides in photo 2.
No power cord or plug is visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'barely used' and 'bought new last year'.

claims.evidence: Photos show some surface wear and scuffs, but no direct proof of usage history. The interior rack appears clean, but no proof of usage duration.

claims.claim: Had bigger alternatives so didn't quite use this one much
claims.evidence: This is a subjective statement about the buyer's decision-making; cannot be verified from photos.

claims.claim: Bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The microwave may not be functional (e.g., no power, damaged internal components, or faulty door seal).
risks.proof: A video showing the microwave turning on, heating a cup of water, and the interior light working.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the power cord and plug, showing it is intact and compatible with Nigerian outlets.

risks.risk: The interior may have hidden damage or residue not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior walls and turntable, showing no stains, cracks, or mold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly dirty or damaged

proof_requests: Video of the microwave in operation, heating water.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Close-up photo of the interior walls and turntable.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
